title: Red Hat Security Advisory: Red Hat Hardened Images RPMs Security Update
description: Red Hat has issued a security advisory for Red Hat Hardened Images RPMs, specifically updating the grafana13.2 package to address CVE-2026-109955. This update includes new RPM versions for multiple architectures. The advisory does not specify detailed technical information about the vulnerability or its impact but categorizes it with medium severity.
aiSummary: This security advisory from Red Hat addresses a vulnerability identified as CVE-2026-109955 in the grafana13.2 package included in Red Hat Hardened Images RPMs. The update provides new package versions (grafana13.2-13.2.3-0.2.hum1) for aarch64, s390x, and x86_64 architectures as well as source RPMs. The advisory references CWE-551, which relates to information exposure through log files or other means, but does not provide further technical details or CVSS scoring. The update is intended to remediate this vulnerability.
aiImpact: The vulnerability affects the grafana13.2 package in Red Hat Hardened Images RPMs and is rated medium severity by Red Hat. While specific impacts are not detailed, the CWE-551 classification suggests potential information exposure risks. There are no known exploits in the wild at the time of the advisory.
